evidence.claim: Kering Eyewear è stata fondata nel 2014 e progetta, sviluppa e distribuisce occhiali per un portafoglio di 15 marchi, con un centro logistico a Vescovana.
evidence.quote: Founded in 2014, Kering Eyewear is the most relevant player in the Luxury Eyewear market segment. The Company designs, develops and distributes eyewear for a complete and well-balanced portfolio of 15 brands || Kering Eyewear strengthened its industrial assets with the official opening of the Logistics Center in Vescovana, in the Veneto Region
